additionalProperties.description: Collection of common configuration options that a user can define as a unit in `config.toml`.

analytics.description: Analytics settings loaded from config.toml. Fields are optional so we can apply defaults.

enabled.description: When `false`, disables OpenAI analytics across Codex product surfaces in this profile. Custom OTLP metrics exporters remain enabled; set `otel.metrics_exporter = "none"` to disable them.

approval_policy.description: Determines the conditions under which the user is consulted to approve running the command proposed by Codex.

oneOf.description: The model decides when to ask the user for approval.

Fine-grained controls for individual approval flows.

When a field is `true`, commands in that category are allowed. When it is `false`, those requests are automatically rejected instead of shown to the user.

mcp_elicitations.description: Whether to allow MCP elicitation prompts.

request_permissions.description: Whether to allow prompts triggered by the `request_permissions` tool.

rules.description: Whether to allow prompts triggered by execpolicy `prompt` rules.

sandbox_approval.description: Whether to allow shell command approval requests, including inline `with_additional_permissions` and `require_escalated` requests.

skill_approval.description: Whether to allow approval prompts triggered by skill script execution.

oneOf.description: Never ask the user to approve commands. Failures are immediately returned to the model, and never escalated to the user for approval.

approvals_reviewer.description: Configures who approval requests are routed to for review. Examples include sandbox escapes, blocked network access, MCP approval prompts, and ARC escalations. Defaults to `user`. `auto_review` uses a carefully prompted subagent to gather relevant context and apply a risk-based decision framework before approving or denying the request. The legacy value `guardian_subagent` is accepted for compatibility.

experimental_compact_prompt_file.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

features.description: Optional feature toggles scoped to this profile.

anyOf.description: Background compaction settings. A threshold alone does not enable the feature.

model_async_compact_threshold_percent.description: Percentage of the model's full context window that starts background compaction. Defaults to 65; valid values are 1–100, including when disabled.

default_exec_yield_time_ms.description: Default yield timeout for code-mode exec calls, in milliseconds.

direct_only_tool_namespaces.description: Exact tool namespaces to expose only as direct model tools. These tools bypass deferral, remain top-level in code-mode-only sessions, and are omitted from the nested code-mode tool surface.

excluded_tool_namespaces.description: Exact tool namespaces to omit from the code-mode nested tool surface.

experimental_show_cell_overhead.description: Show handler duration, code-mode host duration, and harness overhead in each code-mode cell response. Experimental: this option and the response format may change or be removed.

tool_input_schema_max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per rendered tool input type, with a 16,000-byte minimum and default. For ordinary MCP tools, this is also at least their server's explicitly configured input limit.

disable_in_process_fallback.description: Keep code mode fail-closed when the standalone host is unavailable.

delivery_mode.description: Which inference boundaries may receive current-time reminders.

oneOf.description: Allow a reminder before any inference request once the interval is due.
Allow reminders after user input or tool output; new context windows still force one.

anyOf.description: User-configurable prompt, approval, and context settings for Guardian v2.

async_classifier_conversation_token_limi.description: Reset retained async history when the next request exceeds this token estimate. Defaults to 100,000. Fresh requests remain subject to the model's input limit.

allOf.description: Async classifier experiment, resolved once for each parent task.

async_classifier_mode.description: Classifier mode override. Otherwise use the model default, then conversation.

free_guardian.description: Legacy setting retained for config compatibility; the backend now controls Guardian billing.

persist_scores.description: Persist reviewed actions and risk scores to rollout files for debugging.

reasoning_effort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

review_scope.description: Optional tool-call categories available to the Guardian v2 classifier.

computer_use_only.description: Restrict asynchronous classification and fast approvals to browser and computer-use tools.

sandboxed_exec_commands.description: Include sandboxed shell command calls in Guardian v2 classification.

thread_context.description: Deprecated and ignored; thread-owned Guardian context is always enabled.

transcript.description: Bounds and optional sources for the Guardian v2 conversation transcript.

include_images.description: Include recent screenshots from messages and configured tool outputs.

items.description: Optional conversation sources available to the Guardian v2 classifier.

allOf.description: Transcript encoding shared by rendering, provenance instructions and budget recovery.

oneOf.description: Numbered entries with a role prefix and unescaped text.
Host-owned metadata with message text escaped as a JSON string.

transcript_mode.description: Transcript encoding for synchronous Guardian review and asynchronous scoring. Defaults to line.

disable_direct_message.description: Disable the model's direct-message tools; spawning and automatic child results remain available.

disable_native_tools.description: Hide native multi-agent tools while retaining the V2 runtime for host-provided tools.

expose_spawn_agent_model_overrides.description: Exposes `model` and `reasoning_effort` on the multi-agent v2 spawn tool and adds corresponding guidance to root and subagent usage hints.

message_board_in_memory.description: Keep the message board in memory for a training session, including ephemeral sessions.

allOf.description: Connection to a board provisioned by the research host.

bearer_token.description: Board credential supplied directly by a runtime config override.

bearer_token_env_var.description: Read the credential from this environment variable instead of bearer_token.

message_board_remote.description: Use a session-scoped remote board instead of local storage.

preserve_fork_prefix.description: Preserve the parent's model-visible history on full forks and append child instructions. Defaults to true. Legacy compaction without a reusable context baseline still rebuilds.

subagent_developer_instructions.description: Overrides inherited developer instructions for subagents without role-specific instructions.

usage_hint_enabled.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Its value is ignored.

allow_local_binding.description: Permits local servers and direct host-loopback connections and skips the proxy's additional private-network destination checks. Proxy domain rules still apply. Defaults to true for MXC, which cannot enforce false; otherwise defaults to false.

additionalProperties.description: Declarative description of an environment-backed credential family.

items.description: Authentication formats supported by declarative credential providers.

url_prefix_from_env.description: Environment variable containing an additional URL prefix or hostname.

url_prefixes.description: URL prefixes authorized for injection. Bare loopback hosts imply HTTP; other bare hosts imply HTTPS.

server_names.description: MCP servers whose tools should omit the legacy `mcp__` namespace prefix.

reminder_at_remaining_tokens.description: Remaining weighted-token values that trigger reminders when crossed.

oneOf.description: Send the actor credential and a runtime assertion together during migration.
Send only the runtime assertion as the request credential.

mode.description: How the sleep tool is selected when its feature gate is enabled.

oneOf.description: Preserve the existing model and legacy clock configuration defaults.
Register sleep regardless of the model or legacy clock configuration.

auto_compact_fallback_buffer_tokens.description: Additional tokens available after the compaction threshold for fallback note-taking.

auto_compact_fallback_prompt.description: Developer message sampled before an automatic context-window rollover.

guidance_message.description: Guidance appended to the context-window metadata in a developer message.

reminder_message_template.description: Reminder template. `{n_remaining}` is replaced with the tokens remaining before auto-compaction.

reminder_threshold_tokens.description: Number of tokens remaining before auto-compaction when the wrap-up reminder is emitted.

use_history_notes_extension.description: Whether to expose the built-in history and notes extension.

error_on_tool_collisions.description: Fail the turn when multiple tools share the same effective name.

turn_metadata_includes_tool_info.description: Include authoritative tool information in per-turn request metadata.

A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

auto_recap.description: Generate automatic conversation recaps when the terminal is unfocused. Defaults to `true`. Disabling this leaves `/recap` available on demand.

allOf.description: When mouse selections are copied on release.

oneOf.description: Use the terminal-specific default.
Copy every nonempty transcript, footer, or composer mouse selection on release.
Require an explicit copy action.

copy_on_select.description: Copy selected transcript, footer, or composer text when the mouse button is released. Defaults to `auto`: enabled except in direct terminals known to forward their native copy shortcut (Ghostty 1.2+, Kitty on macOS, Windows Terminal, and VS Code on Windows). Unknown terminals, Ghostty without a recognized version, and tmux/Zellij default to copying.

copy_on_select_clear_selection.description: Deselect read-only transcript or footer text after Copy on select confirms delivery. Editable composer selections remain visible. Defaults to `false` and has no effect when Copy on select is off.

disable_paste_burst.description: When true, disables burst-paste detection for typed input entirely. All characters are inserted as they are received, and no buffering or placeholder replacement will occur for fast keypress bursts. Overrides the legacy top-level `disable_paste_burst` setting. Defaults to `false`.

allOf.description: Optional visual effects. Disabling an effect preserves its underlying activity.

effort.description: Animate reasoning-effort changes in the composer and footer.

progress.description: Animate activity bullets and loading spinners.

title.description: Blink the terminal-title indicator when user action is required.

effects.description: Individual visual effects. Each also requires animations to be enabled.

fullscreen_transcript.description: Own the fullscreen transcript, including scrolling, selection, and search. Defaults to `true`; alternate-screen restrictions take precedence.

allOf.description:
Raw keymap configuration from `[tui.keymap]`.

Each context contains action-level overrides. Missing actions inherit from built-in defaults, and selected chat/composer actions can fall back through `global` during runtime resolution.

This type is intentionally a persistence shape, not the structure used by input handlers. Runtime consumers should resolve it into `RuntimeKeymap` first so precedence, empty-list unbinding, and duplicate-key validation are applied consistently.
Shortcuts specific to the shared agents overview.

One action binding value in config.

This accepts either:

1. A single key or chord string (`"ctrl-a"` or `"ctrl-x ctrl-s"`). 2. A list of alternative bindings (`["ctrl-a", "ctrl-x ctrl-s"]`).

An empty list explicitly unbinds the action in that scope. Because an explicit empty list is still a configured value, runtime resolution must not fall through to global or built-in defaults for that action.

This accepts either:

1. A single key or chord string (`"ctrl-a"` or `"ctrl-x ctrl-s"`). 2. A list of alternative bindings (`["ctrl-a", "ctrl-x ctrl-s"]`).

An empty list explicitly unbinds the action in that scope. Because an explicit empty list is still a configured value, runtime resolution must not fall through to global or built-in defaults for that action.

keymap.description:
Keybinding overrides for the TUI.

This supports rebinding selected actions globally and by context. Context bindings take precedence over `global` bindings.

model_availability_nux.description: Startup tooltip availability NUX state persisted by the TUI.

mouse_scroll_speed.description: Mouse wheel speed multiplier for transcript scrolling, based on one row per event. Defaults to `1.0`. Positive fractional values slow scrolling; values above `1.0` speed it up.

oneOf.description: Emit TUI notifications only while the terminal is unfocused.
Emit TUI notifications regardless of terminal focus.

notification_condition.description: Controls whether TUI notifications are delivered only when the terminal is unfocused or regardless of focus. Defaults to `unfocused`.

notification_method.description: Notification method to use for terminal notifications. Defaults to `auto`.

notifications.description: Enable desktop notifications from the TUI. Defaults to `true`.

pet.description:
Pet id to preselect in the terminal pet picker.

Custom pet ids resolve against CODEX_HOME/pets/<pet-id>/pet.json.

oneOf.description: Anchor the pet to the bottom of the current TUI composer viewport.
Anchor the pet to the physical bottom of the terminal screen.

pet_anchor.description:
Where the terminal pet should anchor vertically.

Defaults to `composer`, which follows the current TUI composer viewport.

additionalProperties.description: One reusable prompt or slash command submitted through the TUI composer.

input.description: Plain-text input, limited to 8,000 UTF-8 bytes.

label.description: Optional short name for the picker and shortcut hints.

presets.description: Saved inputs keyed by a single digit (`0` through `9`).

question_esc_back.description: Escape returns from async questions to the composer, preserving the answer draft.

raw_output_mode.description: Start the TUI in raw scrollback mode for copy-friendly transcript output. Defaults to `false`.

allOf.description: Optional rich renderers. Disabled renderers preserve the original source.

lists.description: Render Markdown bullets and task-list markers as Unicode symbols.

math.description: Render math expressions using Unicode notation.

mermaid.description: Render Mermaid code blocks as diagrams.

tables.description: Render pipe tables, including tables inside Markdown fences.

rendering.description: Rich content rendering. Independent of animations and visual effects.

allOf.description: Working directory to use when resuming or forking a session.

oneOf.description: Use the directory where Codex was launched.
Use the latest working directory recorded in the selected session.

resume_cwd.description: Working directory to use when resuming or forking a session. When unset, prompt if the current and session directories differ.

allOf.description: Right-click text paste when the fullscreen TUI has no selection.

oneOf.description: Enable on Windows/WSL/Linux, except recognized terminal-owned paste paths.
Enable on supported local platforms; selection and terminal-owned paste still win.
Leave right-click paste to the terminal.

right_click_paste.description: Right-click text paste fallback. Defaults to `auto` (Windows/WSL/Linux). `on` also enables macOS; neither mode reads over SSH or in recognized VS Code terminals. This controls the fullscreen fallback, not the terminal's own paste binding.

screen_reader_detection_done.description: Records the one-time screen-reader detection attempt. Either value skips detection.

allOf.description: Preferred layout for the resume/fork session picker.

session_picker_view.description: Preferred layout for resume/fork session picker results.

show_server_version_notice.description: Show informational notices about connected app server version differences. Defaults to `true`; this does not control compatibility errors or version status.

show_tooltips.description: Show startup tooltips in the TUI welcome screen. Defaults to `true`.

status_line.description:
Ordered list of status line item identifiers.

When set, the TUI renders the selected items as the status line. When unset, the TUI defaults to: `model-with-reasoning`, `current-dir`, and `thread-name`.

status_line_use_colors.description: Color status line items with colors derived from the active syntax theme. Defaults to `true`.

terminal_resize_reflow_max_rows.description: Trim terminal resize-reflow replay to the most recent rendered terminal rows when the transcript exceeds this cap. Omit to use Codex's terminal-specific default. Set to `0` to keep all rendered rows.

terminal_title.description:
Ordered list of terminal title item identifiers.

When set, the TUI renders the selected items into the terminal window/tab title. When unset, the TUI defaults to: `activity`, `thread-name`, and `project-name`. The `activity` item spins while working and shows an action-required message when blocked on the user.

theme.description:
Syntax highlighting theme name (kebab-case).

When set, overrides automatic light/dark theme detection. Use `/theme` in the TUI or see `$CODEX_HOME/themes` for custom themes.

vim_mode_default.description: Start the composer in Vim mode (`Normal`) by default. Defaults to `false`.
